sourceSynonymSkipped.taken: The printed text was not added: it belongs to another Ingredient.
sourceSynonymSkipped.none: The printed text was not added: the rows had no printed text.

variant.name: Variant title

archive.label: Archive Recipe
archive.confirm: Archive this Recipe? It disappears from browsing and from the picker for new Variants. Its Variants keep working.

tips.inheritedHint: Untick a Tip to hide it on this Variant.
tips.noInherited: The Base Recipe has no Recipe Tips.

translations.hint: English is the source. A blank field falls back to English. Save the Recipe first so new lines, Steps and Tips appear here.
